what: the ZII handed to SIMILT inside ELUSTR2 (P6D request 1), for the frozen Hefei 2022 case, from the write-only instrumented unmodified original CALMET 6.5.0
why: P6D's SIMILT port uses the reference ZI in `zface(k) <= amax1(zi+0.001, zimini)`, which early-stops one level in hour 80 (2022-01-04 09); ELUSTR2 overwrites its local ZI through MIXHTST/MIXHT2ST before SIMILT, so the value SIMILT receives is not the grid ZI

source.subroutine: ELUSTR2 (called by STHEOR per surface station, itself called by DIAGNO)

insertion.when: inside ELUSTR2, immediately before the SIMILT call (the zii it receives)

source.write_only: see dgm-audit.json: MET.DAT is byte identical to the untouched original and to the frozen reference

binary.header: int32[8] = kpt, packed YYYYJJJHH, seconds, IS, JS, nx, ny, nz

ZII_TO_SIMILT.meaning: mixing height handed to SIMILT at the station cell; ELUSTR2 overwrites its local copy of ZI through MIXHTST/MIXHT2ST before the call

ZICONVI_AFTER_MIXHTST.meaning: convective mixing height after the same station-cell MIXHTST call

ZI_GRID_ENTERING.meaning: grid ZI at the station cell as MIXHTST received it (the grid array is not written back)

ZICONV_GRID_ENTERING.meaning: grid ZICONV at the station cell as MIXHTST received it

DPTT.meaning: the station cell's /TJMP/ lapse-rate memory, which MIXHTST updates in place

EL.meaning: Monin-Obukhov length at the station cell

USTAR.meaning: friction velocity at the station cell

QQH.meaning: station sensible heat flux passed to MIXHTST

RHO.meaning: air density at the station cell

ZZANEM.meaning: station anemometer height passed to SIMILT

int_tags.NS: surface station index passed to SIMILT
int_tags.NEARU: nearest upper-air station to the cell
int_tags.IMIXH: mixing-height option (1 = Maul-Carson land, OCD water)

missing_sentinel.note: no value is missing at this point

time.label: packed YYYYJJJHH beginning time plus seconds

cross_check.claim: the grid ZI ELUSTR2 reads at hour h is the post-AVEMIX ZI of hour h-1 written by point 4 of dgm_state.bin
